title: Forged in Blood
description: A third life mod with a dark twist.
body:
## **Warning: This mod is intended for multiplayer. If you're in singleplayer you can get locked out of your world permanently.**

**Forged In Blood** adds a new block, **the Altar**, a **life system**, and a **sacrificial knife**. 

Every time you die, you'll see the heart in the bottom right of your screen decay. Once you've died 3 times, you'll be locked into spectator mode.

If someone stabs themself with a **sacrifical knife**, they lose a life but gain the "Bleeding" effect. This can be used to start a ritual at the **altar**.

If a player who lost all their lives flies over to an active ritual, it will be consumed and they will revive.
